mapper.sql: FROM crm_aftersale a JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=a.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id JOIN sys_user own ON own.id=a.owner_id JOIN sys_user creator ON creator.id=a.created_by LEFT JOIN sys_user helper ON helper.id=a.helper_id LEFT JOIN crm_sales_order s ON s.id=a.order_id LEFT JOIN crm_shipment h ON h.id=a.shipment_id

SELECT a.*,c.company_name customer_name,c.owner_id customer_owner_id,o.dept_id customer_owner_dept_id, own.real_name owner_name,helper.real_name helper_name,creator.real_name creator_name,s.order_no,h.shipment_no, (a.order_id IS NULL AND a.issue_type<>'CONSULTATION') source_pending
mapper.select: ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT * FROM crm_aftersale_item WHERE case_id=#{id} ORDER BY id
SELECT e.*,u.real_name actor_name FROM crm_aftersale_event e JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.actor_id WHERE e.case_id=#{id} ORDER BY e.id DESC
SELECT id,order_no,status FROM crm_sales_order WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND deleted=0 AND status IN('CONFIRMED','COMPLETED') ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id,case_id,actor_id,filename,mime_type,created_at FROM crm_aftersale_image WHERE case_id=#{id} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM crm_aftersale_image WHERE case_id=#{caseId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id,customer_id,contact_name,phone,landline,wechat,email FROM crm_contact WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND status=1 ORDER BY is_primary DESC,id
SELECT DISTINCT a.owner_id id,own.real_name name WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY a.owner_id
